paragraphs: Agil. R' Chanina bar Agil, [Bava Kamma 54b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.54b.29),[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli spells the name Rabbi Chanina ben Agil. Hyman gives bar instead.

The question about the two versions of the Ten Commandments continues at [the beginning of 55a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.55a.1-2). [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2829&lang=en) also calls Rabbi Chanina Agil’s son.
